architecture.style: coverage-aware uncertainty-aware multi-fidelity evidence graph with a closed discovery loop
architecture.executor_model: registered semantic capabilities rather than legacy stage-number APIs
architecture.evidence_model: content-addressed append-only evidence with explicit provenance and claim bindings
architecture.decision_model: claim-specific evidence sufficiency, applicability, uncertainty, and limitations
architecture.selection_model: expected scientific information gain under explicit compute/resource constraints

frozen_invariants: Operational status is distinct from scientific verdict.
Applicability is claim-specific and cannot be inferred from operational success.
Historical v1/B-series evidence remains immutable historical provenance.
Legacy stage identifiers may appear only as provenance or compatibility metadata in new v2 APIs.
A future sealed qualification cohort must not be consumed until the intended v2 qualification protocol is frozen.
Public AI tools must preserve evidence IDs, artifact IDs, protocol identity, limitations, and scientific/operational separation.
MCP or Plugin adapters may translate transport/protocol framing but must not weaken scientific semantics.

mcp.mapping_rule: one frozen semantic tool specification maps to one MCP tool contract

chatgpt_codex_plugin.mapping_rule: reuse the same semantic names, structured schemas, verdict semantics, and provenance fields

integration_targets.adapter_rule: integration adapters may reshape invocation metadata only; they must not silently reinterpret evidence or claims

public_tool_contract.exposure_rule: only implemented and scientifically admitted capabilities may be exported from rhombus.tools

tool_catalog.name: ingest_evidence
tool_catalog.intent: append source-bound scientific evidence without silently promoting claims

tool_catalog.name: get_candidate_evidence
tool_catalog.intent: retrieve evidence and claim bindings for an exact candidate identity

tool_catalog.name: propose_candidates
tool_catalog.intent: propose candidates from a declared source or generator under explicit constraints

tool_catalog.name: validate_candidate_structure
tool_catalog.intent: assess static chemical, geometric, representation, and provenance validity

tool_catalog.name: get_domain_assessment
tool_catalog.intent: return claim-specific applicability/domain evidence for an exact candidate and model/protocol context

tool_catalog.name: relax_structure
tool_catalog.intent: relax an exact structure with an explicitly identified atomistic model and protocol

tool_catalog.name: assess_finite_temperature_stability
tool_catalog.intent: test whether a host structure remains dynamically meaningful under declared conditions

tool_catalog.name: classify_transport_regime
tool_catalog.intent: classify whether trajectory evidence supports a qualified transport regime without implying conductivity

tool_catalog.name: quantify_ionic_transport
tool_catalog.intent: estimate explicit ionic transport observables under declared conditions and sufficiency rules

tool_catalog.name: assess_model_agreement
tool_catalog.intent: compare sufficiently independent atomistic models and expose disagreement without treating same-lineage agreement as independent confirmation

tool_catalog.name: assess_novelty
tool_catalog.intent: assess novelty against a declared reference universe

tool_catalog.name: assess_synthesizability
tool_catalog.intent: evaluate synthesis-oriented evidence without claiming practical success absent support

tool_catalog.name: assess_application_fit
tool_catalog.intent: evaluate a candidate against a versioned application profile

tool_catalog.name: resolve_claims
tool_catalog.intent: resolve evidence-bound scientific claims without collapsing uncertainty or missing evidence into one score

tool_catalog.name: select_next_experiment
tool_catalog.intent: select the next authorized evidence-gathering action from explicit uncertainty, coverage, promise, cost, and risk information

tool_catalog.name: build_evidence_manifest
tool_catalog.intent: build an immutable evidence manifest for exact claims and artifacts
